The clinical presentation and laboratory findings are highly consistent with **nephrotic syndrome**, defined by the classic tetrad: (1) heavy proteinuria (≥3.5 g/day), (2) hypoalbuminemia (<3.0 g/dL), (3) edema, and (4) hyperlipidemia. The patient meets all four criteria:
